svg.title: MediaLog — Library walk
svg.desc: A first-person walk down an endless corridor of book spines toward a warm exit light, after the old 3D maze screensaver. Primary brand colour #18223a, plain MediaLog wordmark. Brick maze walls become shelves of spines in one-point perspective; the floating exit becomes a lit doorway; Spines use brand navy, steel, paper and tan; the floor keeps a wooden warmth.
